name: Merv
content_gm: Real name Janine Cody. Former outlaw gang leader — gang now dead/imprisoned. Leads The Baker's Dozen mercenary band from Revel Regional. Secret safe under wash basin in her quarters (6-letter word lock) contains Minor Health Potion Recipe, Greatstone, Major Stride Potion, key to storage shed #27 (embezzled gold/treasure, proof she's skimmed handling fees for years). On Day -1 leaves Baker for Sargrad to meet a secret crew for a heist against a Councilium emissary, coordinated via secret comms scroll with a Councilium spy; contact goes silent, emissary never arrives, she races back to Baker to grab her stash and vanish under a new identity.
content_player: Merv runs The Baker's Dozen out of Revel Regional, a derelict former corporate HQ. She's Baker's information broker — knows how to find the Seer in the Sand.

name: Calder
content_gm: Dwarf, one of the two Snatch players in the Baker's Dozen bunkhouse (Snatch = chess-like game with a few hundred rules). Bunks with Quill.
content_player: A dwarf who works for Merv, often found playing Snatch with Quill in the bunkhouse.

name: Quill
content_gm: Faerie, one of the two Snatch players in the Baker's Dozen bunkhouse. Bunks with Calder.
content_player: A faerie who works for Merv, often found playing Snatch with Calder in the bunkhouse.

name: Maude, the Seer in the Sand
content_gm: ~300 lb Fungril living in a hut/tent in the Tanaroch Desert, southeast of Baker. One of 5 sister Seers (Sand, Stone, Storm, Sea, Shadow), linked via mycelial network for instantaneous communication. At the dawn of the Aether Centennial, loses connection to all sisters except the Seer in the Stone.
content_player: A prophet living somewhere in the Tanaroch Desert. Regarded as one of five sister Seers scattered across the world.

name: Mayor Mikkie Tomson
content_gm: Grizzled old mayor of Baker. Dresses like a dandy — top hat.
content_player: Grizzled old mayor of Baker, dresses like a dandy in a top hat.

name: Irwin Ironwrench
content_gm: Runs the Tinkering and Repair Shop in Baker. The killer in the Two Nights in Tanaroch murder mystery.
content_player: Runs the Tinkering and Repair Shop in Baker.

name: The Bloodviper Syndicate
content_gm: Highly organized, deeply feared criminal syndicate. Operates The Dusty Ledger in Baker. Leader not yet named (Kassandra Vess is leading candidate). After the Heistus Interruptus scene, gifted the party a bag of gold embroidered with 'BS'.
content_player: A highly organized, deeply feared criminal syndicate with a presence in Baker.

name: The Ultharii
content_gm: Octopus-like precursor civilization, self-regarded as gods. Created the Daemon (Destroyer of Worlds) to fight the return of the Elevated, and designed the Searchlight Obelisks to protect Genesis — but imprisoned the Daemon themselves when they judged him too dangerous, which is why the Obelisk system failed (only the Daemon could operate it). 3500 years ago, genocided by the Keepers of the Order (enforcement arm of the Federation of the Elevated) after the Elevated discovered the Ultharii had learned Aether weaving.
content_player: An ancient precursor civilization, largely forgotten, tied to ruins like the Searchlight Obelisks scattered across the region.
